title: OpenClaw Skills for Sales Teams: CRM, Outreach, and Lead Research on Autopilot
summary: The best OpenClaw skills for sales teams in 2026: automate CRM updates, lead research, outreach sequences, and pipeline reporting with your AI agent.
body_markdown: The outreach sequence writer skill drafts emails. Most sales teams configure the agent to deliver drafts to Telegram for approval before sending. Fully autonomous sending is supported but requires explicit setup — most teams prefer the human-in-the-loop model for outbound.
